The Studio

Most businesses don't need more technology. They need technology that behaves.

SUNEXA is a modern digital solutions studio. We build websites, custom software and the maintenance and hosting that keep them alive a year from now. That's the whole scope — and we do all of it under one roof, so there's no handoff, no blame game, no chasing three vendors to fix one button.

We work the way a good contractor does: we look at the site, we measure twice, we tell you what it costs and how long it takes, and we don't leave until the door closes properly.

So if you run a bistro that needs table reservations, a guesthouse that needs direct bookings without commission, an agency that needs a lead engine, or a founder who needs an internal tool that doesn't exist yet — you're exactly who we built this studio for.

No jargon. No mystery invoices. No project that stalls at 60%. Just a digital presence that pulls its weight every single day.

01 / Principle

Clarity beats cleverness

If your customer needs more than five seconds to understand what you sell, the design failed — not the customer.

02 / Principle

Built to be handed over

Clean code, documented setup, editable content. You own the domain, the hosting, the files and the accounts. Always.

03 / Principle

Launch is the midpoint

Sites age. We plan for year two: updates, backups, speed, security and the small changes that keep it relevant.

How it goes

Five steps. No mystery, no drift.

You'll always know which stage we're in, what's being done, and what we need from you. Most builds run three to six weeks end to end.

01

Discover

We start with a conversation, not a questionnaire. What you sell, who buys it, what's currently costing you time.

  • Kick-off call
  • Content inventory
  • Scope & fixed quote
02

Design

Structure first, then surface. You see real screens with your words and your images — never a generic template with a new coat of paint.

  • Wireframes
  • Art direction
  • Two review rounds
03

Build

Clean, fast, accessible code. Forms, bookings, dashboards, CMS — whatever the business actually needs, wired properly.

  • Development
  • Content loading
  • Device QA
04

Launch

Domain, hosting, SSL, analytics and search submission handled by us. You get a walkthrough and the keys to everything.

  • Deployment
  • Handover session
  • 30-day safety net
05

Support

Updates, backups, speed checks and small edits. Your site keeps working as hard in month twelve as it did on day one.

  • Monitoring
  • Monthly report
  • Priority changes
— Typical build: 3–6 weeks — 50% deposit, 50% at launch — One point of contact throughout

About SUNEXA

A digital studio for people who run real places.

SUNEXA is a modern digital solutions studio focused on websites, software and the digital experiences wrapped around them. We were built on a simple observation: small and mid-sized businesses were being sold either a low-cost template or an enterprise project, and almost nothing that actually fit in between.

So we sit in the middle deliberately. Big enough to take on custom software and complex integrations. Small enough that the person you speak to is the person building your site.

We're not a growth-hacking agency and we won't promise you ten thousand visitors by Friday. What we promise is this: a website or tool that loads fast, reads clearly, works flawlessly on the phone your customers actually hold, and can be changed next year without hiring anyone new.

Start a conversation

Ideas to Impact The line we hold ourselves to — nothing leaves the studio that only looks good.
Ethos 01

Say the price early

Quotes are fixed and itemised. Surprise invoices are a failure of process, not of the client.

Ethos 02

Design for the counter, not the award

If the person at the front desk can update the menu in ninety seconds without calling us, the design worked.

Ethos 03

Performance is a feature

Beautiful and heavy is useless on a hotel's weak Wi-Fi. We budget for speed from the first commit.

Ethos 04

Stay after launch

The relationship is the product. Maintenance, hosting and the occasional honest opinion are part of it.

Questions

Things people ask us first.

Still unsure? Message us on WhatsApp — you'll get a real answer, usually the same day.

Ask directly

Essential is ₹10,000 and Studio is ₹25,000 for most business websites, depending on page count and whether it needs booking, menu or listing functionality. Bespoke starts from ₹39,000, while Custom projects are quoted after reviewing scope, features, integrations and technical complexity. You receive a fixed, itemised number before work begins.

An Essential site runs about two weeks. Studio builds typically take three to six weeks including content gathering and review rounds. Bespoke software is scheduled in stages after a discovery workshop. Delays on your side — like content arriving late — simply push the timeline, they don't change the price.

They're the reason the studio exists. Restaurants, salons, gyms, guesthouses, agencies, independent retailers and clinics make up most of our work. You get the same design and engineering attention as a larger company — just scaled to a budget that makes sense for your size.

Yes. We audit what you have, tell you honestly whether it can be improved or should be rebuilt, and migrate content, domain and email without downtime. If your current site is fine and only needs care, we'll say so and offer maintenance instead.

On Studio and Bespoke builds, yes — you get a content manager with fields named in plain language, a handover walkthrough, and a short reference guide. Text, images, prices, menus and listings are all editable without touching code. Anything you can't do comfortably, our maintenance plan covers.

Maintenance and hosting are quoted based on the selected scope. They cover updates, daily backups, security monitoring, uptime alerts, managed servers, SSL, CDN, mail routing, DNS and annual domain renewal. Both are month-to-month with 30 days' notice — and your domain stays in your name.

Every build includes 30 days of free post-launch support for fixes and tweaks. After that you can move onto a care plan, request work as needed, or take it entirely in-house — you own the code, the accounts and the credentials either way.

Restaurants and food service, hotels and guesthouses, real estate, coaching and consulting, fitness studios, beauty and wellness, retail, and early-stage startups. If your industry isn't listed, we'll learn it — we always start by asking what your customers ask you.
